summary: Camden National Corporation filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) announcing a quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share payable on July 31, 2026 to holders of record on July 15, 2026. This is an ordinary dividend declaration by a bank holding company with no special-situation characteristics such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return event beyond a regular dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine current report regarding a standard quarterly dividend and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
